text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Spe-kun? I don't think you 
have anything to lose by trying.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing! Are these custom-made 
supplements handcrafted by 
Tachyon-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And packed with nutrients, smooth 
beautiful skin, a sparkling coat, and 
other effects are a surprise after 
drinking...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! How about it? A special service 
just for you, right now... completely free 
of charge!

It looks like Agnes Tachyon is closing in 
on Special Week with some suspicious sales 
pitch...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Free!? A-Are you sure!? Thank you so much, 
Tachyon-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: All right, let's get right to it—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You'd better not... do that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Cafe... and you too, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...There's no telling what might happen. 
Hair growing out, glowing in the dark...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Glowing?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Glowing is splendid, isn't it?! It 
causes no particular issues in my daily 
life!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And if I become a sacrifice for the 
evolution of Umamusume in the process, 
that is my greatest desire!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Without sacrifice, what could one possibly 
hope to gain in the first place?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Aren't you the only one who's 
satisfied and gaining anything from 
this...?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... I'm so sorry! I knew it, I think 
I'll pass after all—!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ah, my precious Umamusume test subject...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I will too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Hold on, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Spe-kun gave me the slip, you see. So take 
responsibility and drink this for her!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I've always wondered... wouldn't it be 
simpler if you just drank it yourself...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll drink it! However, results 
from just myself alone are meaningless!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Two or three people wouldn't be anywhere 
near enough to get solid proof!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I must decline.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~? Why would you say that~? Come on~ 
Cafe, back me up here~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To obtain high-precision results, we need 
to test all sorts of Umamusume under 
numerous conditions~.

Agnes Tachyon is throwing a tantrum like a 
child... In this situation—
choice_data_list: I'll drink it for you instead.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... Even if you drink it, you're not an 
Umamusume, so...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Don't be selfish to people who are 
lending you a hand.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, alright. Since you're showing this 
much motivation, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, Cafe, I think you could stand to 
learn from Trainer-kun's enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You have it rough too, don't you...

Under Manhattan Cafe's pitying gaze, I 
headed to the laboratory together with 
Agnes Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Please, Cafe~.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...You're persistent.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Mmph!?

Manhattan Cafe pulled a medicine out of 
Agnes Tachyon's pocket and tossed it into 
the open mouth begging for it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Kh... S-So bright...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... This is a valuable experience in 
its own right... but it's so blinding I 
can't see a thing! My eyes hurt!

Agnes Tachyon continued to glow for three 
whole days and nights afterward...
